youtube_title: Silver Down 35% From Its Peak. Why? 🥈 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Silver was ₹3.1 lakh/kg on 13 May 2026. On 31 Oct: ₹2 lakh. About 35% down.

Why: fears of another US Fed rate hike (higher rates make metals that pay no interest less attractive), costly crude, rising yields, and a tech-stock sell-off that forced leveraged traders to sell. October alone: about -15%. Week of 24-31 Oct: about -9%. Silver swings much harder than gold, both ways.

Rule: keep metals a small slice of your money, buy in parts, never with borrowed money.
Moral: Don't chase a rally. Don't panic in a fall.

Source: Goodreturns India rates (31 Oct 2026). Prices as of 31 Oct 2026.
Education only, not investment advice.
